description: Muaat: Star Forge (starforgeTile_<pos> -> starforge_destroyer_<pos>), agent Umbat (exhaustAgent_muaatagent_<faction> -> umbatTile_<pos>), commander Magmus (gain1tgFromMuaatCommander), hero Nova Seed (novaSeed_<pos>) audit-gaps-2: Umbat is an ACTION used here on Letnev's turn, so the base save carries agentTimingGate=off (TI4_AGENT_TIMING per-game switch). Adjudicator Ba'al (PoK hero): 'Choose 1 system that contains 1 or more of your war suns; that system cannot be a home system or Mecatol Rex' -- the original scenario fired it on 304, Muaat's own home system (tile 04), which the leaders-audit check correctly refuses; it now expects that refusal and fires Nova Seed on a war sun in 103 (Lodor).
